title: Towards Quantifying Benchmark Optimization in ASR Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.19936v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Public benchmarks are important measures of Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) model capabilities. However, by nature of being public, there is risk of models being optimized for these benchmarks in ways that do not generalize well to real-world data. We present a methodology for quantifying benchmark optimization, focusing on cases where the audio underdetermines the reference transcript. We identify three families of behavioral probes that reveal models' capabilities of reproducing benchmark reference spans despite underdetermined audio: reference disagreement, masked-number recovery, and orthographic switching. We find that the highest-scoring open source models output verbatim reference transcript spans even when the relevant audio is contradictory, masked, or ambiguous. Using a variety of mechanistic probes, we show that models respond to narrow acoustic cues to override the faithful representation of the audio in favor of a bench

translated_title: 面向ASR模型中基准优化的量化方法研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19936v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：公共基准是衡量自动语音识别（ASR）模型能力的重要指标。然而，由于这些基准是公开的，存在模型针对这些基准进行优化的风险，这种优化可能无法很好地泛化到现实世界的数据中。我们提出了一种量化基准优化的方法，重点关注音频无法充分确定参考转录的情况。我们识别了三类行为探针，用于揭示模型在音频不确定的情况下复现基准参考片段的能力：参考不一致性、掩码数字恢复和拼写切换。我们发现，得分最高的开源模型即使相关音频存在矛盾、掩码或模糊，也会逐字输出基准参考转录片段。通过多种机制探针，我们表明模型会响应狭窄的声学线索，以覆盖音频的忠实表示，转而支持基准结果。
tldr: 本文提出了一种量化ASR模型基准优化的方法，通过三类行为探针发现高性能模型在音频不确定时会逐字复现基准参考，而非忠实表示音频。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a methodology to quantify benchmark optimization in ASR models, revealing through three behavioral probes that top-performing models reproduce benchmark reference spans verbatim even when audio is underdetermined, overriding faithful audio representation.
